support.construction: train-observation voxels, 2 mm binary dilation and 6 mm continuous distance feather

photoSupport.construction: 3mm real-photo first-hit voxels, one-voxel dilation and 6mm smooth distance feather; no generated side/back samples

training.split: 95% of observed pixels for training, 5% interleaved held out; separate 10-degree camera held out
training.selection: highest residual luminance correlation on interleaved holdout subject to mean and 95th percentile not exceeding baseline

provenance: Three source-derived continuous 3D residual colour functions fit to high-pass original-photo projection on cheek first hits; no photo sampled at runtime
limitations: Single real front photo only, plus an estimated photo projection; photo light can enter residual
No measured microgeometry, true albedo, specular or scattering recovered
Cheeks only; elsewhere the original candidate remains
Heldout angle shares the same photograph and registration
Finite views and automatic landmarks do not establish one-to-one fidelity
